chunks.text:
[Intro]
{a quiet atmospheric entrance: two distant pick-taps echo down the gallery, the low drone opens, and one bright crystal chime glints far above}
positive_styles: low warm horn and pulse-wave lead singing a slow solemn melody that moves by steps
sparse high crystal-chime glints of broken triads
deep sustained synth bass drone on the root
distant dry pick-tap percussion echoing in a cavern
melancholy lamplit mining town in the deep dark, faint warmth of fire-lamps

chunks.text:
[Main Theme]
{the slow miners' melody on the low horn: a rising leap that climbs, then moves only a step or two, solemn and warm, never hurried; a pick-tap every bar}
